text:
marta: quick question  we have a security backport that needs shipping to 2.3.x. options: bump patch on main and cut 2.3.5, create a dedicated pinned 2.3.x release, or tag a hotfix branch and let deploybot flow it?

sam: i'd prefer a normal patch bump (2.3.5) unless it changes any public API surface. keeps semver clean.

raj: patch bump + explicit metadata sounds right. we should avoid freeform suffixes like "-security" in the tag itself.

emily: FYI last time auto-pin caused a bunch of downstream infra pulls. can't repeat that. :grimacing:

nina: yeah that was because lockfile updates were auto-merged. for a security backport i'd like manual deploy and a short ops checklist in the release notes.

ops-bot: automated-scan: backport-type=patch-only; impacted=auth, token-service; auto-deploy=blocked (manual verification required).

marta: ok manual deploy then. semantic question: tag = 2.3.5 or 2.3.4-security? what's our policy?

sam: policy is simple: patch-only => increment patch. Use release metadata rather than mangling the tag.

raj: agree. add release metadata labels so tooling can detect security backports. e.g. meta: [security-backport, manual_ack].

emily: can deploybot be configured to require a human ack when meta includes security-backport?

deploy-bot: yes. deploy-bot supports require_ack if release.notes or release.meta contain a specific flag. Suggested snippet for PR: 
```
Release: 2.3.5
Meta: [security-backport, manual_ack]
Ops-checklist:
  - smoke auth endpoints
  - validate token rotation
  - run e2e login flow
```

nina: great. also include CVE info in the public changelog if it's been assigned. redact internal tracker IDs though.

marta: agreed. changelog line should be concise: "2.3.5  Security: CVE-YYYY-XXXX (token validation)  manual deploy required"

sam: don't auto-pin stable-channel customers. we should send notifications + recommended upgrade steps to account teams. auto-pin felt risky.

raj: i'll add a PR comment to remind folks: do not update global lockfiles unless the change is required for the patch build. that caused surprises previously.

emily: also flag monitoring dashboards to expect increased 5xx noise during verification window. ops-bot can schedule post-deploy checks.

ops-bot: scheduled-checks: +15m smoke, +1h acceptance, +24h regression. alerts will escalate to oncall if thresholds exceeded.

marta: summary: cut 2.3.5 (patch bump), include meta labels [security-backport, manual_ack], deploybot blocks auto-deploy until human ack, release body contains CVE and ops checklist, do NOT auto-pin stable customers, and avoid lockfile churn. i'll open the release PR with that template now.

sam: thanks. please ping #release-channel when PR is ready. :rocket: 

marta: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/releases/PR-1223 (includes template and checklist). requesting manual ack from @raj @nina.

raj: acked and leaving a small note on lockfile.

nina: acked after smoke run. all good. merging in 10m.

emily: merging looks good to me.

deploy-bot: merge-detected: PR-1223 merged. deployment blocked until manual_ack present.

marta: manual ack present from @raj @nina. triggering deploy now.

ops-bot: deploy started. will post results at +15m and +1h.

emily: nice and quiet. thanks everyone. low noise thread.

marta: closing thread after post-deploy checks pass.
